findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_answer, get_weekly_tip, search_articles, get_article, find_related_content, check_security_posture, assess_risk, read_warning, prepare_terms_request · Private data: find_answer, estimate_transaction_fee, find_adviser, check_security_posture, assess_risk, explain_gap, draft_will_starter, prepare_terms_request · Public sink: search_articles, get_article, choose_security_path, read_market_position, read_supply_schedule, explain_referral_program, check_security_posture, assess_risk, prepare_enquiry, prepare_referral_application, prepare_terms_request · Destructive: find_answer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_answer, get_weekly_tip, search_articles, get_article, find_related_content, check_security_posture, assess_risk, read_warning, prepare_terms_request · Private data: find_answer, estimate_transaction_fee, find_adviser, check_security_posture, assess_risk, explain_gap, draft_will_starter, prepare_terms_request · Public sink: search_articles, get_article, choose_security_path, read_market_position, read_supply_schedule, explain_referral_program, check_security_posture, assess_risk, prepare_enquiry, prepare_referral_application, prepare_terms_request · Destructive: find_answer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
